verdict.rationale: There is no documented retention policy or user-facing data deletion control. The only indirect support is the dedicated instance/VPC deployment with "full data isolation" and a community report of self-hosting via Docker, both of which let users keep data under their own control. Beyond that, the evidence shows API deletion of workflows and source connectors (configuration objects, not processed data) and a GDPR-conformance claim. missing for 10: configurable retention periods for uploaded files and job outputs, an explicit API/UI to delete processed documents and results, documented default retention/zero-retention behavior, and independent corroboration.
